input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay" and "volume" return no purchase-commitment language anywhere in the Agreement. Charges under § 4.1 are payable only for Services specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), i.e. for ordered or actual usage only, which is the preferred position. § 11.5 (Capacity Planning) allocates capacity-planning responsibility to Customer but imposes no committed capacity or volume floor, and § 3.4 lets Customer terminate the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for convenience on one month's notice. The only residual exposure is the reference in § 3.4(b) to "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments"; no such charges appear in the reviewed text, so there is no take-or-pay without an exit — we would simply confirm on diligence that the attachments contain no minimum-volume or shortfall charge. No redline required.
